text:
What’s Propelling Essendant Inc (NASDAQ:ESND) After Higher Shorts Reported? Posted by Ash 39 pm
The stock of Essendant Inc (NASDAQ:ESND) registered an increase of 3.41% in short interest. ESND’s total short interest was 748,500 shares in December as published by FINRA. Its up 3.41% from 723,800 shares, reported previously. With 187,700 shares average volume, it will take short sellers 4 days to cover their ESND’s short positions. The short interest to Essendant Inc’s float is 2.28%.
The stock increased 0.97% or $0.12 $12.46. About 116,280 shares traded. Essendant Inc. (NASDAQ:ESND) has risen 42.94% uptrending. It has outperformed by 42.94% the S&P500.
Essendant Inc. operates as a wholesale distributor of workplace items in the United States and internationally. The company has market cap of $469.02 million. It supplies janitorial supplies, breakroom items, foodservice consumables, safety and security items, and paper and packaging supplies. It currently has negative earnings. The firm also offers technology products, such as imaging supplies, data storage, digital cameras, and computer accessories; and computer hardware, including printers and other peripherals to computer resellers, office products dealers, drug stores, grocery chains, and online merchants.
